name: Sensory Systems
summary: How sense organs turn physical stimuli into neural signals and how the brain builds perceptions from them.

topics.name: Principles of sensory coding: transduction, receptive fields and adaptation
Psychophysics: thresholds and signal detection theory
Vision: optics of the eye and phototransduction
Retinal circuits and the central visual pathways
Visual cortex: feature detection, visual streams and object recognition
Hearing: cochlear mechanics, hair cells and auditory pathways
The vestibular system: balance and spatial orientation
